propositions: Agentic runs waste 40-70% of request budget on identical duplicate tool calls that re-execute and re-pay round-trip costs without memoization
Identical read-only tool calls (read_file, search_files, list_directory, show_ticket) should be cached and return results without re-execution on subsequent identical invocations

Error-prefixed results (e.g. 'Error: cannot read') must not be memoized and must re-execute on retry to allow transient recovery, while deterministic sentinel-empty results like '(no matches)' are memoized as honest stable answers
Duplicate tool signatures must trigger escalating static nudges (level-1 on first repeat, level-2 thereafter) to steer the model away from loops while remaining byte-stable for prompt caching
The runaway guard actuator must continue to observe all memoized duplicate signatures and maintain its distinct-ratio windowing and abort behavior at the same call index
Write and non-deterministic tools like record_criterion_verdict must remain exempt from memoization and always execute
